answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 50204 Country: India Title: I saw in my dream to recite Quran Majeed in mosque many times. Please, interpret it. Question: I saw in my dream to recite Quran Majeed in mosque many times. Please, interpret it. Answer ID: 50204 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 277/245/H=02/1435) The dreams are nice. They mean that you will be given special taufiq of taqwa and purity. If you pay exclusive attention to service of mosque, tilawat and following sunnah in each matter, then it is hoped that you will experience progress quickly, in-shaAllah! You should also study these books: Fazail Amam, Fazail Sadawat, Hayatul Muslimeen and Muntakhab Ahadees. If possible, gather the family members and read out these books for one or half an hour daily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
